data.one_liner: A chart library for Flutter supporting line charts and bar charts from simple arrays.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to create line charts and vertical bar charts by specifying data as simple arrays. Features iterative auto-layout strategies for labels and supports positive/negative values and custom options.
use_when: You need basic line charts or vertical bar charts quickly from simple arrays.
You want built-in iterative auto-layout strategies for chart labels.
avoid_when: You need advanced chart types like pie charts, gauges, or complex graphs.
You need highly customizable interactive tooltips and rich animations.
strengths: Iterative label layout strategy to prevent label overlap.
weaknesses: Limited chart type support compared to larger alternatives.
Dependencies and font configurations can be restrictive.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: More feature-complete and actively maintained charting library supporting line, bar, pie, and scatter charts.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Enterprise-grade charting library with a vast array of chart types and high performance.
